details:
This started happening about a month or two ago after a specific update (though I can't recall which one, sincerest apologies), but I wasn't yet confident that it was a VRChat bug; I am now, though, as this doesn't happen anywhere else except in VRChat and has continued to happen for a while now:

In most instances I join, when I point at a UI element with the laser pointer, at first everything works as intended and there is no jitter. But then, when I go to click something, either in the VRChat menu or the world's UI, nothing happens. Then, when I go to move a slider (again, including sliders in VRChat menus like volume settings), again, the laser pointer doesn't jitter at all, but the target I'm clicking and holding DOES jitter, always horizontally (regardless of my hand/arm orientation). As a result, it's very difficult to click anything, or use sliders, in any menus anywhere.

HOWEVER, this only happens MOST of the time, and always persists until I join another world (I'm not currently sure if rejoining the same world fixes this, but the only way I've found to fix it so far is to go to a different world and hope it doesn't also happen there too; it may have to do with distance from world origin, but the jitter from that has never been THIS bad, so I'm inclined to believe that's not the whole story if it's even relevant).

I am using a Valve Index with the official Knuckles controllers, three Vive 3.0 full-body trackers, and four Valve 2.0 Base Stations. This is both to communicate my hardware in case it's relevant, but also to clarify that this isn't a tracking issue; again, the laser pointer itself doesn't jitter, only the targets it's clicking jitter, and this issue doesn't occur anywhere in SteamVR, only in VRChat.
title: Laser Pointer target often jitters after being clicked, making it difficult to click any UI elements or interact with sliders (either in worlds or the native VRChat UI)
